brand.title: Brand
brand.subtitle: Your brand kits and the things you shoot: products, people, props. The chat and the studio take them from here.

kits.emptyText: A kit keeps your colors, fonts, logo and tone of voice in one place, so every picture and video looks like your brand.
kits.deleteConfirm: Delete the kit “{name}” with its logos, fonts and pictures?

colors.title: Colors
colors.hint: Brand colors, most important first. The label says what a color is for, e.g. “background” or “accents”.

tone.title: Tone of voice
tone.hint: How the brand speaks: words to use and to avoid, how long sentences are, emoji or not. Used when texts and captions are written.
tone.placeholder: e.g. Friendly and short. No slang, at most one emoji.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.hint: Upload TTF or OTF files. The type (serif, sans serif…) is read from the file itself, without AI. Change it if it is wrong.
fonts.formats: TTF or OTF, up to {mb} MB.
fonts.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789
fonts.guessed: The file does not say its type, so “{category}” was picked. Check it.

elements.title: Brand elements
elements.hint: Logos, frames, stickers and other pictures the brand reuses. The first logo is the main logo of the kit. Drag a picture by its handle to change the order.

kindHints.logo: Your logo. The first one is the main logo of the kit.
kindHints.sticker: A small picture to put on top of a picture.
kindHints.plate: A backing for text: the caption goes on top of it.
kindHints.badge: A badge or tag: price, discount, “new”.

references.title: Style references
references.hint: Pictures that show the look you want: light, colors, mood. They are examples of style, not things to copy.

kit.formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {mb} MB.

asset.name: Name
asset.notePlaceholder: When and how to use this picture

subjects.hint: Products, people and props that must look the same in every picture. Add a few photos from different angles and a short description.
subjects.oneOffHint: Quick subjects added in a chat for one job. Move the ones you want to keep to the library.
subjects.emptyText: Add a product, a person or a prop with a few photos, then use it in the chat.
subjects.oneOffEmptyText: They appear when you add a quick subject in a chat.

card.removeConfirm: Delete the subject “{name}” with its photos?
card.noPhotos: Without a photo this subject never reaches generation. Add at least one.
card.photosHint: The first {sent} photos in this order are sent to the model (up to {max} can be kept). Reorder them to pick the angles you want.
card.photoMax: No more than {n} photos per subject.
card.sentHint: This photo is sent to the model (first {n}).
card.notSentHint: This photo is not sent to the model. Move it forward.
card.descriptionPlaceholder: What this is: shape, color, details that must not change.
card.sourcePhoto: Written by AI from the photos
card.describeNeedsPhoto: Upload at least one photo first.
card.describeHint: The AI looks at the first {n} photos and writes the description. If the subject has no name, it suggests one.
card.describeOverwrite: This description was written by hand. Replace it with the AI one?
card.focusPlaceholder: What to take from the photo: e.g. the bracelet only
card.focusHint: The AI describes whatever fills the frame. Say what you actually need: everything else in the photo is treated as background and stays out of the description.

errors.bad_colors: The colors could not be saved.
errors.bad_color: “{value}” is not a color. Use a code like #1A2B3C.
errors.bad_image_type: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures can be added.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too big: up to {max_mb} MB.
errors.font_unreadable: This is not a TTF or OTF font, or the file is damaged.
errors.bad_order: The order could not be saved. Reload the page.
errors.too_many_assets: Up to {max} pictures of one kind per kit.
errors.subject_photo_limit: No more than {max} photos per subject.
errors.subject_no_photos: Upload at least one photo first.
errors.subject_describe_empty: The AI returned an empty description. Try again.
errors.bad_cover: The cover must be one of the subject’s photos.
